rev.name: Kayla
rev.text: Nice stay, convenient

rev.name: Chun Kit
rev.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Reykjavík! The apartment was beautiful, spacious, and very comfortable. We especially loved the large bathroom and the beautiful lighting, which made the whole place feel warm and cozy. The room was also very spacious, and we were pleasantly surprised that even the sofa bed felt just like a proper bed!
Everything was thoughtfully designed, making our stay really enjoyable. Definitely one of the nicest Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. Highly recommended, and we would happily stay here again!

rev.name: Michael
rev.text: This is my second time at Arni’s, and I’m already looking forward to a third! Exactly as described and super easy to find. The church, rainbow street, bookstore bar where they play live music every night.. all mere minutes away! Looking forward to my next stay!

rev.name: Shannon
rev.text: Arni's place is fantastic! The location is perfect, the apartment was very comfortable, the guidebook and directions were so helpful and Arni was very responsive! If you want to be in the heart of Reykjavik, this is the perfect space.... especially if you're queer bc you are so close to the queer bar and rainbow road! I'll definitely be back!

rev.name: Alyssa
rev.text: Had an excellent stay at this apartment. Host generously let us arrive early to check in. The space was very comfortable, clean, great location. Appreciated the fully stocked Nespresso!

rev.name: Wonhsien
rev.text:
One of the best place I’ve ever been.
Everything is provided; fully equipped.
Easy to find the place and very friendly for families with large luggage.
Totally worth the price!

rev.name: Gareth
rev.text: Really enjoyed my stay here! The apartment was very spacious, clean and had everything you could need. Fantastic location right on Laugavegur, with shops, restaurants and everything else right on your doorstep. Really appreciated being allowed to check in early too. rev.name: Blanca Margarita
rev.text: Everything was perfect! The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and perfectly located close to everything. Communication with the host was smooth and easy. Highly recommended!

rev.name: Kira
rev.text: It was perfect for what we needed. Arni was a great host who went above and beyond for us. It’s a fantastic location, very easy to find everything and very walkable area. Apartment was clean, host was super responsive and made sure we were informed on everything we needed. I would definitely stay here again in the future! rev.name: Sara
rev.text:
We stayed at two of Arni’s apartments and loved them both. Arni is incredibly responsive, you cannot beat the location - it’s right in the center of the Reykjavík nightlife and shopping and the apartments are all well furnished with incredibly comfortable beds. 
I wouldn’t hesitate recommending any of Arni’s properties - in fact I’ve already recommended one for friends visiting Iceland in November!

rev.name: Anushree
rev.text: Great property, located in the city centre and easy to find. Arni is a very amiable host and was very helpful with checking and out. Great value for money and perfect for small groups.

about:
You have exclusive use of this apartment. You will not be sharing anything with other guests.

We are right in the middle of downtown, on the main street. It is really fun to walk around and people on this street.

All the main attractions of the city centre, like “The Big Church”, Sun Voyager, Harpa Concert Hall, Parliament Square, Town Hall, City Pond, Rainbow Street are all walking distance from our front door.

There are about 100 restaurants, coffee houses and bars within walking distance.
practical:

You have access to washing machines and dryers in the basement - no charge.
notes:
We have 13 different apartments, all different sizes, all located in the same building.  Each apartment is fully self-contained and you have exclusive use of the apartment you book.  

There is an elevator and stairs that services each floor of our building.

Luggage Storage – yes, we have a secure luggage room for as long as you need.

Kitchen Equipment

Rice Cooker / Air Fryer - if not available in your apartment you will find them on the 4th floor - on the shelf as the lift doors open. 

Laundry Facilities – yes, there are washing machines and dryers in basement of the building.  There is no cost to use these machines, there is washing powder available for you.  This is a self service facility available 24 hours each day.

Because we are on the Main Street and in the absolute centre of Reykjavik, you will find many shops, restaurants, bars, cafes and popular tourist attractions - all with-in walking distance, please take the time to look at our Airbnb Guidebooks.

If you have any questions, we are always available for you at anytime.
